'''Glow berry mash''' is the simple preparation of [[Glow Berries|glow berries]]. It heals {{Hp|2}} and grants the Aura intrinsic for 3 seconds, making every other creature within 50 blocks glow.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/glow_mash.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
Glow berries cook into glow berry mash in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]] in 5 seconds. Picking up glow berries unlocks the oven recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating glow berry mash takes 0.8 seconds and heals {{Hp|2}}. A bell sound plays, and 2.4 seconds later every other entity within 50 blocks glows for 3 seconds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/effects/soul_sight_apply_glow_3.mcfunction}}</ref> See [[Glow Berries#Aura]].

Obtaining glow berry mash unlocks [[Glow Berry Jam|glow berry jam]] and [[Glow Berry Crumble|glow berry crumble]].

=== Crafting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

== Advancements ==
* ''Powerful Flavors'': cook an intrinsic ingredient. Obtaining any of the 11 simple preparations of the ordinary intrinsic ingredients completes it.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/cook_food.json}}</ref>

== History ==

== Trivia ==
* Glow berry mash is a renamed rotten flesh, and the aura is triggered by eating anything with the rotten flesh model, so vanilla rotten flesh (for example from chests that still contain it) also triggers it.
